record.question: The preferred vascular access for long-term hemodialysis is:
record.explanation: Answer D: AV fistula. An arteriovenous fistula is generally preferred for long-term hemodialysis access when feasible because it has lower infection/thrombosis risk and better durability than a catheter; access choice is individualized. Reference: https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/vascular-access; https://www.cdc.gov/dialysis-safety/about/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
